posts.zh:
dsh-review-loop 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-93a25b11144899f1d50c.html
posts.en:
dsh-review-loop is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-93a25b11144899f1d50c.html
